snippet.title: LoK Ascendance Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🩸 Legacy of Kain: Ascendance is here. A fast, retro action platformer built around vertical movement, fluid combat, and skill-driven play. Step into a dark fantasy world brought to life through beautifully crafted pixel art and animated cutscenes.

⚔️ Chain vicious melee strikes, evasive dashes, and supernatural attacks as combat flows seamlessly into traversal and environmental puzzles. Experience multiple perspectives across Nosgoth’s history.

🕯️ Featuring an original score by Celldweller and returning voice talent from the Legacy of Kain series, Ascendance delivers a new chapter forged in legacy and driven by momentum.

🗡️Ascendance isn’t granted. It is earned, with blood.

Developed by Bit Bot Media 

Available now on 
🎮 PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018010

🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4233530/Legacy_of_Kain_Ascendance/

🎮 Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9mt815crgdqz

🎮 Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/p/legacy-of-kain-ascendance-69642d

🎮 GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/Legacy_of_Kain_Ascendance

🎮 Nintendo Switch 1&2 : available now!
